_comment: Which completed-item passives the TFT engine models, keyed by the item's apiName in the MetaTFT data.
An item's plain stats come from its stat line automatically; this file only covers the text below it.
Numbers are never written here: each effect references a row of the item's own curve table, with
`scale` / `minusOne` / `mult` to turn the row's tooltip convention into an engine unit (fractions).
Effects the engine knows: precision, ampVsTank, asPerSecond (+asStackDuration), adPerAttack (+maxStacks,
asAtMax), adapPerAttack (+maxStacks, ampAtMax), apPerInterval (+interval), apAfter (+at), ampPerCrit
(+ampDuration, maxStacks), manaPerAttack, manaPerCrit, manaMult, adapMult, startingMana, adPct, ap,
asPct, crit, amp, armor, mr, manaRegen, byRole, sunderOnHit, shredOnHit, burnOnHit, sunderAura,
shredAura, burnAura. `note` is shown in the dashboard as what stays unmodeled.
`excluded` items are left out of the enumeration entirely.
_note: Item passives that heal, shield, revive or reduce damage taken are not modeled: the carry is never hit in this fight.

DA_Bloodthirster.note: the once-per-combat shield is not modeled

DA_BrambleVest.note: damage reduction and the thorns are not modeled

DA_Crownguard.note: the shield itself is not modeled; the ability power lands when it would expire

DA_EdgeOfNight.note: the untargetable proc and heal are not modeled

DA_Evenshroud.note: the aura only reaches the dummies from a unit whose range is within it; the combat-start resists are not modeled

DA_GargoyleStoneplate.note: resists per attacker are not modeled

DA_GiantSlayer.note: the bonus amp applies to the two tank dummies, not the third

DA_HandOfJustice.note: counted at full health, where its attack damage and ability power are doubled; the omnivamp is not modeled

DA_HextechGunblade.note: the ally healing is not modeled

DA_IonicSpark.note: the aura only reaches the dummies from a unit whose range is within it; the dummies never cast, so the mana-burn damage never fires

DA_Morellonomicon.note: the wound does nothing to a dummy

DA_ProtectorsVow.note: the low-health mana and shield are not modeled

DA_RedBuff.note: the wound does nothing to a dummy

DA_SpiritVisage.note: the regeneration and durability are not modeled

DA_StrikersFlail.note: crit is an expected value, so each attack adds a crit-chance share of a stack

DA_SunfireCape.note: the burn is applied to the current target; the health is a plain stat

DA_TitansResolve.note: stacks only from attacking here: the carry is never hit

excluded.DA_ThiefsGloves: Thief's Gloves — two random items each round, and it takes all three slots
excluded.DA_TacticiansCape: Tactician's Cape — team size, no combat stats
excluded.DA_TacticiansCrown: Tactician's Crown — team size, no combat stats
excluded.DA_TacticiansShield: Tactician's Shield — team size, no combat stats
